slides.texte_overlay:
5 signs someone secretly wants
your attention number 3
never fails

1. they notice details

we only notice small changes in people we already look at closely. a new haircut, a different jacket, a tiny change in your mood, and they spot it first.

2. the fast reply that stops

they answer you instantly and then go quiet. it isn't indifference, they simply caught themselves caring a little more than they ever wanted to show you.

3. they say your name

if they talk about you when you're not there, you're on their mind. we mostly mention the people we think about, which is exactly why this sign never fails.

4. the silent watcher

they watch your stories and posts but never react. watching without showing it is often the clearest sign of attention someone is trying very hard to hide.

5. unexpected topics

when conversations with you drift away from the usual small talk, their attention stays. surprising stories make people want more and more of your time.
